data_architecture.canonical_bar_policy: Raw, unadjusted five-minute Tiingo OHLCV is canonical source evidence. Split-adjusted price and volume are deterministic derived analytical views and never replace raw fills.
data_architecture.alpaca_role: Existing Program 002 evidence may be a read-only structural comparison only. No new Alpaca request and no substitution or blended canonical price is allowed.
data_architecture.provider_failure_action: STOP. Another provider requires a new prospective user decision.

force_fill_policy.missing_interval_representation: Absent and explicitly recorded as absent.
force_fill_policy.violation_action: Fail source qualification or acquisition before dataset admission.

split_adjustment.event_ratio: splitTo / splitFrom from positive finite source fields, reduced exactly as a rational number
split_adjustment.cumulative_factor_for_session_s: Product of splitTo/splitFrom for active events with s < exDate <= 2026-07-31.
split_adjustment.analytical_price: raw OHLC divided by cumulative factor
split_adjustment.analytical_volume: raw volume multiplied by cumulative factor
split_adjustment.numeric_representation: Exact reduced rational numerator and denominator using standard-library Fraction; no float or discretionary rounding.
split_adjustment.event_cancellation_or_revision: A changed active event creates new correction lineage and invalidates any prior unreviewed derived view.

cash_distribution_adjustment.reason: Every position opens and closes within one session; price features are same-session; no position owns an overnight distribution entitlement.
cash_distribution_adjustment.scope_expansion_rule: Any overnight holding, cross-session price return, or total-return benchmark requires a new prospective plan before use.

symbol_identity.baseline: Exact frozen ticker strings and issuer identities.
symbol_identity.reason: Current Tiingo documentation conflicts on availability and treats access as entitlement-gated.
symbol_identity.ticker_change_action: Fail qualification unless a prospectively reviewed issuer-backed mapping exists before any strategy result.

missing_data_policy.minimum_cross_section: All twelve ranking symbols plus SPY.
missing_data_policy.trade_session_required_grid: Every expected XNYS regular-session five-minute bar for all thirteen symbols. Early-close sessions are context-only and require their complete scheduled grid.
missing_data_policy.incomplete_trade_session_action: Exclude the entire session from every configuration, benchmark, and later context use.
missing_data_policy.relative_volume_context: Use the twenty most recent prior complete XNYS sessions under the frozen feature rule. An incomplete session is never context; it does not become a substitute evaluation date.

rationale.representativeness: The 0.5 percent global ceiling limits direct sample loss to seven of 1,499 full sessions.
rationale.cross_sectional_consistency: Whole-session exclusion keeps the ranking universe identical for every candidate and benchmark.
rationale.chronology: One loss per fixed block and no date replacement prevent later evidence from changing block length or membership.
rationale.missingness_concentration: The rolling-quarter, consecutive-session, and same-symbol annual ceilings reject clustered provider defects and likely regime or instrument bias even when global loss is small.
rationale.known_gap_independence: Thresholds are defined from block length and concentration risk, not from a count chosen to admit the nine known MDY omissions.

return_blind_numeric_derivation.fixed_block_one_percent_and_one_session: Each discovery or test block contains about 125-126 full sessions. One excluded session is about 0.8 percent, while two are at least 1.59 percent. A one-percent ceiling therefore permits one isolated defect but rejects two in the same six-month evidence block.
return_blind_numeric_derivation.global_half_percent_and_seven_sessions: The global rate is half the per-block ceiling so losses that are individually sparse cannot accumulate near the allowed block maximum across the program. floor(1499 * 0.005) = 7 fixes the count without reference to observed provider gaps.
return_blind_numeric_derivation.rolling_63_sessions: Sixty-three XNYS sessions approximate one trading quarter. More than one excluded session inside that horizon is treated as regime or calendar clustering even when each fixed block stays below one percent.
return_blind_numeric_derivation.consecutive_sessions: Two adjacent excluded sessions indicate a continuing outage or market-state mechanism rather than an isolated coordinate defect, so the maximum run length is one.
return_blind_numeric_derivation.same_symbol_rolling_252_sessions: Two failures for the same symbol within about one trading year establish recurrent instrument-specific missingness that can bias a cross-sectional rank or relative-volume feature, so only one is allowed.
return_blind_numeric_derivation.required_context_zero: The first twenty context sessions are a fixed feature input. Losing one changes every affected relative-volume denominator and there is no prospectively equivalent substitute, so no loss is allowed.
return_blind_numeric_derivation.known_mdy_check: The already exposed five-session MDY pattern fails the fixed-block, rolling-quarter, same-symbol annual, and source-qualification zero-missing-bar controls; no ceiling was selected to admit it.

missing_data_policy.full_acquisition_failure_action: If any ceiling is exceeded, source qualification fails and the program stops without provider substitution or strategy execution.

transaction_cost_model.applies_to: All twelve tradeable ETFs; SPY remains context-only.
transaction_cost_model.reserve_interpretation: The all-in reserve covers possible commission, regulatory pass-through, rounding, and other small-order friction without claiming a broker-specific fee schedule.

public_liquidity_sanity_check.measure: Issuer-published current 30-day median full NBBO spread; lower-bound sanity check only.
public_liquidity_sanity_check.interpretation: The 5 bps Normal adverse allowance per side is at least five times the largest current median half-spread, before the separate 1 bps reserve.

return_blind_basis_and_challenge.repository_precedent: The existing strategy-neutral conservative-bps-v1 baseline uses 5 bps adverse fill plus 1 bp commission reserve per fill; Program 003 adopts those values without using Program 002 returns.
return_blind_basis_and_challenge.historical_execution_sanity_check: The repository's prior SIP calibration found SPY/QQQ p99 half-spreads no greater than 0.36 bps, but that evidence does not cover this universe or establish future fills.
return_blind_basis_and_challenge.independent_challenge: Six bps per side is not an empirical historical upper bound for all twelve ETFs. It may understate episodic adverse selection, bar-open execution uncertainty, latency, market impact, queue position, partial fills, or broker-specific costs.
return_blind_basis_and_challenge.disposition: Retain 6 bps only as the frozen Normal planning assumption because its 5 bps adverse component is five times the largest current issuer median half-spread and matches the pre-existing return-blind repository baseline. It is not sufficient alone for qualification.
return_blind_basis_and_challenge.qualification_interpretation: The inherited robustness gates require Stress A, Stress B, Normal-delay-2, and Normal-delay-3 to pass. A candidate that passes Normal but fails any required higher-cost or delayed scenario cannot qualify.
return_blind_basis_and_challenge.future_cost_evidence_rule: No post-result evidence may lower a cost or delay. Evidence that the envelope is too low stops the program and requires a new prospective decision.

fixed_corporate_action_controls.split: XLB, XLE, XLK, XLU, and XLY must each identify the issuer-announced 2-for-1 split effective for trading on 2025-12-05.
fixed_corporate_action_controls.distribution: IWM must identify the issuer-published 2024-06-11 ex-date distribution; no dividend adjustment is applied to intraday bars.

pre_transport_gates: The plan used for qualification permits durable create-only raw persistence. Starter and trial plans fail this gate under the current Tiingo Terms of Use.
The account is entitled to the Beta consolidated historical endpoint and the required split and distribution endpoints for all thirteen symbols.
Provider-authored documentation or written terms bind the exact after-hours and force-fill parameter names and explicit false values.
Provider-authored documentation or written terms bind UTC/bar-label, regular-session, five-minute bucket, resampling, correction, and revision semantics.
A future isolated adapter and qualification implementation pass synthetic tests and independent review.
A future one-use authority binds the exact implementation commit, account-plan identity hash, endpoint, sample, limits, and all-false strategy authorities.

request_budget.pagination: Not expected for exact-session requests and not publicly documented. Any pagination, truncation marker, or response-range drift fails qualification unless prospectively bound before authority.

pass_criteria: Exactly 14,742 bars exist at the expected XNYS regular-session coordinates with no duplicate or foreign coordinate.
All nine known MDY coordinates exist as real provider bars; no force-filled or synthetic row is accepted.
Every full control has 78 bars per symbol and the early close has 42 bars per symbol.
Each stored response reparses and rederives to identical canonical structural evidence; provider correction and revision behavior matches the pre-transport contract.
Dates, timestamps, numeric fields, resampling, volume inclusion, after-hours exclusion, and force-fill exclusion match the frozen contract.
The five issuer-known splits and the fixed IWM distribution control match the corporate-action ledger.
Exact rational split factors transform price and volume as specified without float arithmetic.
Raw response bodies, request identities, action records, derived structural counts, and the terminal receipt persist under the licensed plan.
source_qualification.failure_action: Consume the one-use authority, retain only evidence permitted by the applicable license, publish a terminal structural failure receipt, perform no full acquisition, and do not try another provider.
source_qualification.success_action: Publish a structural pass receipt with no strategy return. Full acquisition still needs separate user authorization and review.

full_exposed_projection.estimate_basis: 1,546,818 expected rows at a planning envelope of 200-400 raw JSON bytes per row; Tiingo bandwidth accounting and actual response size remain unverified.

full_exposed_projection.restart_safety: One create-only receipt per symbol-month/action chain, deterministic pending/completed state, response hash, atomic publication, and resume from the first absent receipt.
full_exposed_projection.starter_bandwidth_risk: Estimated below 1 GB, but qualification must measure provider-counted bytes. Exceeding a prospectively frozen ceiling stops rather than purchases an upgrade.

free_tier_and_low_cost_feasibility.projection_condition: Only if the user later accepts Tiingo Power and keeps it active while Tiingo data is retained. Current authorized and incurred cost is $0.
